title: 染髮劑在浴室
mood: tender, counting something you don't want to count
subject: dyeing your mother's hair on a chair in the bathroom
caption: Mandarin indie-crossover art pop in the Taiwanese indie-producer idiom. Clean electric guitar through heavy tremolo and spring reverb playing slow arpeggios, upright bass soft and round, drum kit played with brushes very quietly, one muted trumpet entering in the second half, a held Rhodes chord under the chorus. Hazy and washed, the guitar bathed in spring reverb while the voice stays dry and close. Close male voice, half-spoken and unpushed, breath and consonants left in, no vibrato. 82 BPM, A major. Tender, counting something you would rather not count. No pop chorus lift, no strings, no synth pad, no key change, no belting.
lyrics:
[Intro - tremolo guitar alone]

[Verse 1]
媽把椅子搬到浴室 說「反正地板好擦」
她自己買的染髮劑 架上最便宜那盒
手套只有一隻 我用一隻
她說「不用怕弄到我 弄到就算了」

[Pre-Chorus]
她低頭的時候 我才看到她頭頂
白的地方 比她講的多很多

[Chorus]
我慢慢塗 一格一格
她閉著眼 跟我講她同事的女兒結婚了
我沒有回話
我怕她聽出來我在數 數她白了幾公分

[Verse 2]
等三十分鐘 我們就坐在浴室裡
她問我要不要吃水果 我說等一下
她說「等一下就忘記了」 然後她還是去切了
頭上包著塑膠袋 走出去切水果

[Chorus]
我慢慢沖 一格一格
她閉著眼 跟我講她同事的女兒懷孕了
我沒有回話
我怕她聽出來我在數 數還剩幾年

[Outro - guitar and trumpet, fading]
浴室地板 一片一片黑的
我擦了很久
